why_this_file: makellose-500 I3: a release-shipped fixture without a recorded version silently checks the adapter against a frozen format. This states which inspect_ai wrote it and records the measured backward-compat, so a format drift is a visible decision, not an invisible one.

measured_backward_compat.note: inspect_ai 0.3.260 (the pin's measured ceiling) both READS this 0.3.217 fixture and WRITES log_version 2 — the format is stable across 0.3.217..0.3.260, so no second fixture is recorded. Do NOT delete this fixture: it is the backward-compat witness. Record a second fixture at the pin ceiling ONLY when a future measured ceiling writes a different log_version.
